verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v1: yā quṭbu yā ghawthu yā mawlāyā yā wazaru yā muntahā ʾamalī billāhi yā qamaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v2: yā wal-yā ṣ-ṣulḥi fī ḥālī muḥawwilahu ʾilā s-sadādi falā yaʾatī liyā ḍ-ḍararu
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v3: yā muqriba l-ʿabdi lil-mawlā muwaṣṣilahu yā man yaʾummu ʾilā ʾaknāfihi l-basharu
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v4: yā muqtaḍā l-ḥāli fī ḥarfi n-nidāʾi wayā ghiyātha kulli munādi ʿindahu waṭaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v5: yā sirru yā ʾamnu yā maʾawāyā kulli ʾadhā wayā ʾamānu wayā manwāyā yā fakharu
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v6: yā dhukhru yā yusru yā kanza l-ʿufāti wayā makhtūmu maktūmu yā maʿlūmu tushtaharu
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v7: wayā mumiddu ʾabā l-fayḍi l-ʾilahī wayā mawlāyā yā ʾaḥmada t-tijāni yā wazaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v8: yā qudwatī yā ʾimāmī ḥuẓwatī wamalā dhī kaʿbaha l-ḥājji lil-muḥtāji yā ḥajaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v10: ʾinna l-ʾighāthata fīka l-buʿdu yusriʿuhā taʿẓīma qadrika ʿinda llāhi yā qamaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v11: wafayḍu rāḥatika l-muthlā lijūdikum falaysa yushbihuhu baḥru walā maṭaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v12: lam yabki bāki ʾatākum mushtaki ʾarabā ʾillā wafurrija ʿanhu l-ghammu wiḍ-ḍararu
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v13: ʾanta l-malādhu ʾidhā mā shtadda min jalali ʾanta l-maʿādhu ʾidhā l-ʾahwālu tantashiru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v14: ʾanta l-muʿīnu waʾanta l-mustaghāthu waʾan ta l-mustaʿānu wayanjū naḥwaka z-zumaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v15: falam tuḍiʿ ʾanfusu tarʿā birawḍatikum taʾawī ʾilā thamarāti d-dīni tuḥtajaru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v16: lā tantahī shakwatu minnī liʿiṭfikumu liʾanna jūdaka lā yafnā walā yadharu
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v17: tarku shtikāʾi ḥarāmu ʿindakum ʾabadā yā qāḍiyā l-ḥāji fāqḍi l-ḥāja tuqtadiru
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v18: ʿalā n-nabiyyī ṣafiyyī llāhi sayyidinā wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi ʾarbābi l-hudā ftakharū
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v19: ṣalātu rabbī salāmu llāhi khāliqinā mā dhikruhu dh-dhākirūna llāha qad dhakarū
verses.ya-qutbu-c1-v9: naṭūfu ḥawlaka maʿnā kay nuʿʿada mina ṭ-ṭṭawāfi ḥawlaka ḥissā rabbuhum shakarū
